purpose: Classify the four deferred root groups before any formal public release task can ask for registry action. This matrix does not move directories, delete evidence, close R1, or authorize release.

claim_boundary.allowed_user_claim: R1 deferred root groups have a machine-checkable disposition preflight; three groups remain release blockers and one workspace-local state group is excluded from package candidates.
forbidden_claims: R1 historical asset cleanup is complete.
All deferred root groups are release-safe.
Package exclusion proves physical cleanup for historical assets.
The registry release action may proceed.

groups.reason: This group contains validators, control-plane policies, indexes and task truth sources. Parts of compass/tools and references/*.json remain package-visible in the alpha readiness surface, but that visibility is not a historical cleanup disposition.

next_required_tranche.trigger: Before stable public release, or before any claim that internal control-plane roots are physically consolidated.

groups.reason: Prism currently mixes protocol tools, provider policy, formal reports and run evidence. Raw prism/runs is excluded, but prism tools remain package-visible and reports/evidence retention still need a dedicated split decision.

next_required_tranche.trigger: Before stable public release, or when Prism evidence lifecycle needs physical split beyond policy/index controls.

groups.reason: Layer A compatibility is not package-visible today, but whether it belongs in public RedCap remains a product boundary decision. It cannot be silently retired, moved or published by this preflight.

next_required_tranche.trigger: Before public release claims include or exclude Layer A compatibility.

groups.reason: These paths are live local task state, secrets or scratch buffers rather than historical assets to preserve. They must remain unpublished and must not be normalized into public source.

next_required_tranche.trigger: Recheck only when package files/globs or host local-state contract changes.

next_release_rule: Formal public release cannot proceed beyond R1 until every remaining release blocker has either a safe physical split/migration receipt, a Forge-reviewed public export receipt, or an explicit release-blocker disposition accepted by the formal release plan.
